limitations: Eight optional native package variants do not prove eight tested consumer platforms.
Darwin packages use upstream0.5.10 rather than fork0.5.10-zv5; runtime equivalence requires native evidence.
Musl selects a dependency path explicitly; compatible Bun and libc environment remain prerequisites.
Public standalone builds currently target only Linux x64 and Windows x64.
tsImplementationNotes: TS npm uses a Bun shebang launcher. Preservation requires the installed command and behavior, not retaining Bun in a future runtime.

TS standalone builds embed a parser worker and require a drive-letter Windows build workspace. Future rendering implementations need equivalent diagnostics/rendering behavior, not that worker architecture.
